title: OnChainKing
tagline: a DEFAi agent telegram bot which you can use as wallet and for automated defi activities like lending, borrowing, and LP positions etc, future of payments and investing is here
description: This bot can perform on-chain activities such as lending, borrowing, and opening liquidity pool (LP) positions. One of its most important features is the ability to revise LP positions every hour to maximize fees. Additionally, you can use it as a wallet for performing swaps and transfers.You can also use it to sign messages.
how_its_made: This projects leverages privy server wallets to create secured user end wallet based on telegram id and it was build using coinbase ai agent kit , additionally to existing actions we added lending, borrowing and withdrawing actions from AAVE , present this bot only works on base sepolia.
